in_text_mentions: By immunofluorescence and laser scanning confocal microscopy, the positive staining of IgG, C5b-9, C4d, C3d, C1q, MBL, factor B and properdin was further confirmed on the glomeruli of patients with anti-GBM disease (Figure 3).

IgG co-localized with C3d exactly along the GCW (Figure 3A–C). C1q, factor B and properdin co-localized with C5b-9 exactly along the GCW too (Figure 3D–L). Furthermore, properdin co-localized with C3d along the GCW (Figure 3M–O). As for MBL, it was found just partially co-localized with C4d (Figure 3S–U), but was not co-localized with C5b-9 at all (Figure 3P–Q).
